# MediaSimilarityFinder

## Current development version

0.9.2.63

Duplicate photo/video finder. Perceptual 64-bit pHash fingerprints (mirror + 4:3 / 1:1 / 9:16 crops), DTW video comparison with scene anchors and a duration prefilter, GPU-accelerated image hashing on CUDA, incremental SQLite index, persistent GUI thumbnail cache, and a real-time folder monitor with a Qt GUI.

## Repository layout

- The real source tree is `src_unpacked/`.
- `src_unpacked/src/` - engine, pure-C++ common layer (CUDA is a compile-time optional layer behind `gpu_backend.h`).
- `src_unpacked/gui/` - Qt widget application (`mainwindow.cpp` contains Korean UI string literals).
- `src_unpacked/tests/` - CTest tests, named `msf_*_test`.
- `src_unpacked/scripts/` - `build_windows_cuda.ps1`, `build_windows_cpu.ps1`, `package_portable.ps1`.
- `src_unpacked/docs/` - per-build history, architecture notes, `STRUCTURE.md`, and this file.
- `src_unpacked/AGENTS.md` - working rules (docs policy, build baseline 0.9.2.32, working validation line 0.9.2.63, CUDA invariance, release procedure).

## Key entry points

- `src/media_search_engine.cpp` - `MediaSearchEngine::scan()` orchestrates listing, analysis, candidate indexing, similarity, live streaming of matches, checkpoints, persistence, and the GPU counter (`gpuImagesProcessed()`).
- `src/scan_pipeline.cpp` - duplicate detection. Image pairs via `bestMatch`/`thresholdFor`; video pairs run a duration gate then `temporal()` + `video_crop_similarity({threshold,8,2,2.0})`.
- `src/video_fingerprint.cpp` - `VideoFingerprintEngine::build()` (low-variance frame exclusion, scene-change detection, crop fingerprints), `video_similarity()`/`video_crop_similarity()` DTW with `sceneBonus`; versioned SQLite cache (`kCacheFormatVersion==4`).
- `src/database.cpp` - primary SQLite index: file fingerprints, persistent matches, and GUI `thumbs` cache.
- `src/video_sampling.cpp` - `make_sample_plan()` sample timestamps by duration; `sampling_interval()`.
- `src/image_decoder.cpp` / `src/media_pipeline.cpp` / `src/gpu_backend.cpp` - image decode and CPU/CUDA hashing.
- `gui/mainwindow.cpp` - UI, GPU status, persistent thumbnail cache, Pairs/ETR display, preview via Windows shell thumbnail cache first for cached shell entries, then decoders.

## Tests

Current CMake registers 49 tests, including `thumb_cache_test`, `video_reencode_test`, `video_real_test`, `scan_pipeline_test`, `scan_cancel_test`, `scan_streaming_test`, `match_store_test`, `search_engine_test`, monitor tests, candidate tests, image/GPU/pipeline tests, and UI state/layout probes.

## Build & release

- Build: `scripts/build_windows_cuda.ps1 -VcpkgRoot C:\src\vcpkg` (VS 2026 x64, project-local `vcpkg_installed`, `vcpkg.json` is the single dependency source).
- Smoke: `MediaSimilarityFinder.exe --smoke` (offscreen) and `--version`.
- Version bump files: `CMakeLists.txt`, `vcpkg.json`, `gui/main.cpp` (`kVersion`), `scripts/package_portable.ps1`, `src/index_manager.cpp`.
- CI workflows under `.github/workflows/` are historical and currently lag the VS2026/current-version build scripts; do not treat them as the current build standard until updated.

## URLs

Use raw GitHub URLs for source files when programmatic access is needed.
